strategies.title: ReUI Integration
strategies.content: ReUI registered as on-demand remote MCP server at https://mcp.reui.io with official skill in .agents/skills/reui and /reui workflow.

strategies.title: Antigravity Workflow Frontmatter Contract & Global Discovery
strategies.content: All Antigravity workflows must contain description-only YAML frontmatter matching their file stems without disable-model-invocation or metadata tags. Global workflows must be synchronized to ~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/global_workflows/. Major executions must auto-run /learn and finish with a quick /grill-me.

strategies.title: Auto-Learn Trigger Scope High-Threshold Invariant
strategies.content: Post-execution Auto-Learn + quick Grill-Me is scoped strictly to high-threshold major executions (multi-file feature builds, architectural changes, /build-feature, /ship), omitting single-query turns.
